title: Coordinate sign noise
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and let $x\in\{\pm1\}$. Define a random sign by keeping $x$ with the correlation keep probability associated with $\rho$, and otherwise replacing it by $-x$; the resulting probability mass function is the coordinate noise distribution at $x$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the correlation keep probability, so its exact dependence on $\rho$ cannot be stated from the supplied ground truth.
